hooks.command: out=$(flai guard 2>&1); s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 2 ] && { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; case "$s" in 126|127) printf 'flai guard did not run (exit %s): %s\nno guarded call passes until flai is installed and on PATH\n' "$s" "$out" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

[ -n "$FLAI_ROLE" ] || [ -n "$FLAI_STORY" ] || exit 0; out=$(flai guard 2>&1); s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 2 ] && { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; case "$s" in 126|127) printf 'flai guard did not run (exit %s): %s\nno guarded call passes until flai is installed and on PATH\n' "$s" "$out" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
